text.en:
Act Numbered Two hundred and twenty-six, entitled "An Act appropriating two thousand three
hundred and eighty-three dollars and ninety-six cents, in money of the United States, for the provincial
government of Cebu," is hereby amended by adding at the end of section one of said Act the following
"The provincial board is hereby authorized to use the funds mentioned in this section, in its discretion, for the
relief of inhabitants of the province who are in need of assistance in cases where such relief will tend to
promote the pacification of the province."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 23, 1901.
